title: R3D: Revisiting 3D Policy Learning
summary: 3D policy learning promises superior generalization and cross-embodiment transfer, but progress has been hindered by training instabilities and severe overfitting, precluding the adoption of powerful 3D perception models. In this work, we systematically diagnose these failures, identifying the omission of 3D data augmentation and the adverse effects of Batch Normalization as primary causes. We propose a new architecture coupling a scalable transformer-based 3D encoder with a diffusion decoder, engineered specifically for stability at scale and designed to leverage large-scale pre-training. Our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art 3D baselines on challenging manipulation benchmarks, establishing a new and robust foundation for scalable 3D imitation learning. Project Page: https://r3d-policy.github.io/
tldr: This paper identifies training instabilities and overfitting as key challenges in 3D policy learning and proposes a new stable architecture combining a 3D transformer encoder with a diffusion decoder.
tldr_zh: 本文指出了3D策略学习中训练不稳定和过拟合的关键问题，并提出了一种结合3D Transformer编码器和扩散解码器的新稳定架构。
summary_zh: 三维策略学习有望实现卓越的泛化与跨具身迁移能力，但训练不稳定和严重过拟合问题阻碍了其进展，导致无法采用强大的三维感知模型。本研究系统诊断了这些失效原因，发现忽略三维数据增强以及批量归一化的负面影响是主要根源。我们提出一种新型架构，将基于可扩展Transformer的三维编码器与扩散解码器相结合，该架构专为大规模训练的稳定性而设计，并能有效利用大规模预训练。我们的方法在具有挑战性的操作基准测试中显著超越了当前最先进的三维基线，为可扩展的三维模仿学习奠定了全新且鲁棒的基础。项目页面：https://r3d-policy.github.io/

title: A Nonasymptotic Theory of Gain-Dependent Error Dynamics in Behavior Cloning
summary: Behavior cloning (BC) policies on position-controlled robots inherit the closed-loop response of the underlying PD controller, yet the effect of controller gains on BC failure lacks a nonasymptotic theory. We show that independent sub-Gaussian action errors propagate through the gain-dependent closed-loop dynamics to yield sub-Gaussian position errors whose proxy matrix $X_\infty(K)$ governs the failure tail. The probability of horizon-$T$ task failure factorizes into a gain-dependent amplification index $Γ_T(K)$ and the validation loss plus a generalization slack, so training loss alone cannot predict closed-loop performance. Under shape-preserving upper-bound structural assumptions the proxy admits the scalar bound $X_\infty(K)\preceqΨ(K)\bar X$ with $Ψ(K)$ decomposed into label difficulty, injection strength, and contraction, ranking the four canonical regimes with compliant-overdamped (CO) tightest, stiff-underdamped (SU) loosest, and the stiff-overdamped versus compliant-underdamped ordering system-dependent. For the canonical scalar second-order PD system the closed-form continuous-time stationary variance $X_\infty^{\mathrm{c}}(α,β)=σ^2α/(2β)$ is strictly monotone in stiffness and damping over the entire stable orthant, covering both underdamped and overdamped regimes, and the exact zero-order-hold (ZOH) discretization inherits this monotonicity. The analysis provides the first nonasymptotic explanation of the empirical finding that compliant, overdamped controllers improve BC success rates.
tldr: This paper provides a nonasymptotic theory for how PD controller gains affect the closed-loop error propagation in behavior cloning, showing that compliant, overdamped controllers reduce failure rates, which explains empirical findings in robotics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种非渐近理论，用于解释PD控制器增益如何影响行为克隆中的闭环误差传播，表明顺从、过阻尼控制器可降低失败率，从而解释了机器人学中的实证发现。
summary_zh: 位置控制机器人的行为克隆策略继承了底层PD控制器的闭环响应特性，然而控制器增益对行为克隆失效的影响尚缺乏非渐近理论。本文证明，独立次高斯动作误差通过增益依赖的闭环动力学传播，会产生次高斯位置误差，其代理矩阵$X_\infty(K)$主导失效尾部分布。时域$T$任务失败概率可分解为增益依赖的放大指数$Γ_T(K)$、验证损失以及泛化松弛项，因此仅凭训练损失无法预测闭环性能。在保持上界结构特性的假设下，代理矩阵满足标量界$X_\infty(K)\preceqΨ(K)\bar X$，其中$Ψ(K)$可分解为标签难度、注入强度和收缩因子，进而对四种典型工况进行排序：顺应过阻尼工况界最紧，刚性欠阻尼工况界最松，而刚性过阻尼与顺应欠阻尼的排序则取决于具体系统。对于典型标量二阶PD系统，连续时间稳态方差闭式解$X_\infty^{\mathrm{c}}(α,β)=σ^2α/(2β)$在整个稳定象限内关于刚度和阻尼严格单调，同时涵盖欠阻尼与过阻尼工况，且其精确零阶保持离散化继承该单调性。该分析首次为非渐近理论解释了经验发现：顺应过阻尼控制器能提升行为克隆成功率。

title: A Hierarchical Spatiotemporal Action Tokenizer for In-Context Imitation Learning in Robotics
summary: We present a novel hierarchical spatiotemporal action tokenizer for in-context imitation learning. We first propose a hierarchical approach, which consists of two successive levels of vector quantization. In particular, the lower level assigns input actions to fine-grained subclusters, while the higher level further maps fine-grained subclusters to clusters. Our hierarchical approach outperforms the non-hierarchical counterpart, while mainly exploiting spatial information by reconstructing input actions. Furthermore, we extend our approach by utilizing both spatial and temporal cues, forming a hierarchical spatiotemporal action tokenizer, namely HiST-AT. Specifically, our hierarchical spatiotemporal approach conducts multi-level clustering, while simultaneously recovering input actions and their associated timestamps. Finally, extensive evaluations on multiple simulation and real robotic manipulation benchmarks show that our approach establishes a new state-of-the-art performance in in-context imitation learning.
tldr: This paper introduces HiST-AT, a hierarchical spatiotemporal action tokenizer for in-context imitation learning. It employs multi-level clustering of action trajectories, shows improved performance over non-hierarchical methods, and is validated on simulation and real-world robot manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于机器人上下文模仿学习的分层时空动作标记器（HiST-AT）。它采用多级聚类处理动作轨迹，在仿真和真实机器人操作任务上实现了新的最先进性能。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的、用于上下文模仿学习的分层时空动作标记化方法。首先，我们提出一种分层量化方案，该方案包含两个连续的向量量化层级：底层将输入动作分配到细粒度的子簇中，而高层则进一步将细粒度子簇映射到更高层级的聚类。我们的分层方法在主要利用空间信息重构输入动作的同时，性能优于非分层方法。此外，我们进一步扩展了该方法，同时利用时空信息，构建了分层时空动作标记化器（HiST-AT）。具体而言，我们的分层时空方法通过多级聚类，在重构输入动作的同时恢复其对应的时间戳信息。最后，通过在多个仿真环境与真实机器人操作基准测试中的广泛评估，我们验证了该方法在上下文模仿学习任务中实现了目前最先进的性能。

title: DockAnywhere: Data-Efficient Visuomotor Policy Learning for Mobile Manipulation via Novel Demonstration Generation
summary: Mobile manipulation is a fundamental capability that enables robots to interact in expansive environments such as homes and factories. Most existing approaches follow a two-stage paradigm, where the robot first navigates to a docking point and then performs fixed-base manipulation using powerful visuomotor policies. However, real-world mobile manipulation often suffers from the view generalization problem due to shifts of docking points. To address this issue, we propose a novel low-cost demonstration generation framework named DockAnywhere, which improves viewpoint generalization under docking variability by lifting a single demonstration to diverse feasible docking configurations. Specifically, DockAnywhere lifts a trajectory to any feasible docking points by decoupling docking-dependent base motions from contact-rich manipulation skills that remain invariant across viewpoints. Feasible docking proposals are sampled under feasibility constraints, and corresponding trajectories are generated via structure-preserving augmentation. Visual observations are synthesized in 3D space by representing the robot and objects as point clouds and applying point-level spatial editing to ensure the consistency of observation and action across viewpoints. Extensive experiments on ManiSkill and real-world platforms demonstrate that DockAnywhere substantially improves policy success rates and easily generalizes to novel viewpoints from unseen docking points during training, significantly enhancing the generalization capability of mobile manipulation policy in real-world deployment.
tldr: The paper proposes DockAnywhere, a framework to improve viewpoint generalization for mobile manipulation policies by lifting a single demonstration to diverse docking configurations, addressing the view generalization problem.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了DockAnywhere框架，通过将单个演示提升至多种可行的对接配置，解决移动操作中的视角泛化问题，从而改进策略在真实世界部署中的泛化能力。
summary_zh: 移动操作是机器人能够在家庭和工厂等广阔环境中进行交互的基本能力。大多数现有方法遵循两阶段范式：机器人首先导航至停靠点，然后利用强大的视觉运动策略执行固定基座操作。然而，由于停靠点的偏移，现实中的移动操作常受视角泛化问题的困扰。为应对此问题，我们提出了一种名为DockAnywhere的低成本演示生成框架，该框架通过将单一演示提升至多种可行的停靠配置，显著改善了停靠点变化下的视角泛化能力。具体而言，DockAnywhere通过将依赖于停靠的基座运动与跨视角保持不变的密集接触操作技能解耦，从而将轨迹提升至任何可行的停靠点。在可行性约束下采样可行的停靠方案，并通过结构保持增强生成对应轨迹。在三维空间中，将机器人与物体表示为点云并应用点级空间编辑以合成视觉观测，从而确保跨视角下观测与行动的一致性。在ManiSkill及真实平台上的大量实验表明，DockAnywhere大幅提升了策略成功率，并能轻松泛化至训练中未见停靠点的新视角，显著增强了移动操作策略在现实部署中的泛化能力。

title: DEX-Mouse: A Low-cost Portable and Universal Interface with Force Feedback for Data Collection of Dexterous Robotic Hands
summary: Data-driven dexterous hand manipulation requires large-scale, physically consistent demonstration data. Simulation and video-based methods suffer from sim-to-real gaps and retargeting problems, while MoCap glove-based teleoperation systems require per-operator calibration and lack portability, as the robot hand is typically fixed to a stationary arm. Portable alternatives improve mobility but lack cross-platform and cross-operator compatibility. We present DEX-Mouse, a portable, calibration-free hand-held teleoperation interface with integrated kinesthetic force feedback, built from commercial off-the-shelf components under USD 150. The operator-agnostic design requires no calibration or structural modification, enabling immediate deployment across diverse environments and platforms. The interface supports a configuration in which the target robot hand is mounted directly on the forearm of an operator, producing robot-aligned data. In a comparative user study across various dexterous manipulation tasks, operators using the proposed system achieved an 86.67% task completion rate under the attached configuration. Also, we found that the attached configuration reduced the perceived workload of the operators compared to spatially separated teleoperation setups across all compared interfaces. The complete hardware and software stack, including bill of materials, CAD models, and firmware, is open-sourced at https://dex-mouse.github.io/ to facilitate replication and adoption.
tldr: DEX-Mouse is a low-cost, portable, calibration-free teleoperation interface with force feedback for collecting dexterous robot hand manipulation data, showing high task completion rates in user studies.
tldr_zh: DEX-Mouse 是一种低成本、便携、无需校准的遥操作接口，具有力反馈功能，用于收集灵巧机器人手操控数据，在用户研究中表现出高任务完成率。
summary_zh: 数据驱动的灵巧手操作需要大规模且物理一致性的示范数据。基于仿真和视频的方法存在虚实差距与运动重定向问题，而基于动捕手套的遥操作系统需针对每位操作者进行校准，且由于机器人手通常固定于静止机械臂上，导致系统缺乏便携性。现有便携式方案虽提升了移动性，却存在跨平台与跨操作者兼容性不足的问题。本文提出DEX-Mouse——一种基于商用现成组件构建（成本低于150美元）、具备集成动觉力反馈的便携式免校准手持遥操作界面。该界面采用操作者无关设计，无需校准或结构改造，可即时部署于多样化环境与平台。该设备支持将目标机器人手直接固定于操作者前臂的配置模式，从而生成与机器人运动对齐的数据。在多项灵巧操作任务的对比用户研究中，使用该系统的操作者在附着配置模式下实现了86.67%的任务完成率。同时，实验发现相较于所有对比界面的空间分离式遥操作系统，附着配置模式能有效降低操作者的感知工作负荷。完整硬件与软件栈（包括物料清单、CAD模型及固件）已在https://dex-mouse.github.io/开源，以促进系统复现与应用推广。

title: POMDP-based Object Search with Growing State Space and Hybrid Action Domain
summary: Efficiently locating target objects in complex indoor environments with diverse furniture, such as shelves, tables, and beds, is a significant challenge for mobile robots. This difficulty arises from factors like localization errors, limited fields of view, and visual occlusion. We address this by framing the object-search task as a highdimensional Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) with a growing state space and hybrid (continuous and discrete) action spaces in 3D environments. Based on a meticulously designed perception module, a novel online POMDP solver named the growing neural process filtered k-center clustering tree (GNPF-kCT) is proposed to tackle this problem. Optimal actions are selected using Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) with belief tree reuse for growing state space, a neural process network to filter useless primitive actions, and k-center clustering hypersphere discretization for efficient refinement of high-dimensional action spaces. A modified upper-confidence bound (UCB), informed by belief differences and action value functions within cells of estimated diameters, guides MCTS expansion. Theoretical analysis validates the convergence and performance potential of our method. To address scenarios with limited information or rewards, we also introduce a guessed target object with a grid-world model as a key strategy to enhance search efficiency. Extensive Gazebo simulations with Fetch and Stretch robots demonstrate faster and more reliable target localization than POMDP-based baselines and state-of-the-art (SOTA) non-POMDP-based solvers, especially large language model (LLM) based methods, in object search under the same computational constraints and perception systems. Real-world tests in office environments confirm the practical applicability of our approach. Project page: https://sites.google.com/view/gnpfkct.
tldr: This paper presents a novel online POMDP solver (GNPF-kCT) for efficient object search by mobile robots, addressing challenges like limited FOV, occlusion, and growing state/action spaces.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新型在线POMDP求解器（GNPF-kCT），用于移动机器人的高效目标物体搜索，解决了视野有限、遮挡以及状态/动作空间增长等挑战。
summary_zh: 在复杂室内环境（如包含货架、桌子和床等多种家具）中高效定位目标物体，对移动机器人而言是一项重大挑战。该困难源于定位误差、视野受限及视觉遮挡等因素。为此，我们将物体搜索任务建模为一个在三维环境中具有增长状态空间和混合（连续与离散）动作空间的高维部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）。基于精心设计的感知模块，本文提出了一种名为增长神经过程过滤k中心聚类树（GNPF-kCT）的新型在线POMDP求解器来解决此问题。该方法通过以下机制选择最优动作：采用蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）并利用信念树重用来处理增长状态空间；使用神经过程网络过滤无效基础动作；以及通过k中心聚类超球面离散化实现对高维动作空间的高效细化。一种改进的上限置信区间（UCB）策略——其设计融合了置信度差异与估计直径单元内的动作价值函数——引导MCTS的扩展。理论分析验证了所提方法的收敛性与性能潜力。针对信息或奖励受限的场景，我们还引入了基于网格世界模型的猜测目标物体作为关键策略，以提升搜索效率。在相同计算约束与感知系统下，通过Fetch和Stretch机器人在Gazebo中进行的大量仿真实验表明，与基于POMDP的基线方法以及最先进的非POMDP求解器（尤其是基于大型语言模型的方法）相比，本方法在物体搜索任务中实现了更快、更可靠的目标定位。办公室环境中的真实世界测试进一步证实了本方法的实际适用性。项目页面：https://sites.google.com/view/gnpfkct。

title: HRDexDB: A Large-Scale Dataset of Dexterous Human and Robotic Hand Grasps
summary: We present HRDexDB, a large-scale, multi-modal dataset of high-fidelity dexterous grasping sequences featuring both human and diverse robotic hands. Unlike existing datasets, HRDexDB provides a comprehensive collection of grasping trajectories across human hands and multiple robot hand embodiments, spanning 100 diverse objects. Leveraging state-of-the-art vision methods and a new dedicated multi-camera system, our HRDexDB offers high-precision spatiotemporal 3D ground-truth motion for both the agent and the manipulated object. To facilitate the study of physical interaction, HRDexDB includes high-resolution tactile signals, synchronized multi-view video, and egocentric video streams. The dataset comprises 1.4K grasping trials, encompassing both successes and failures, each enriched with visual, kinematic, and tactile modalities. By providing closely aligned captures of human dexterity and robotic execution on the same target objects under comparable grasping motions, HRDexDB serves as a foundational benchmark for multi-modal policy learning and cross-domain dexterous manipulation.
tldr: HRDexDB is a new large-scale, multi-modal dataset of high-fidelity dexterous grasping sequences for human and diverse robotic hands, designed as a benchmark for cross-domain multi-modal policy learning in manipulation.
tldr_zh: HRDexDB 是一个新的大规模、多模态数据集，包含人类和多种机器人手的高保真灵巧抓取序列，旨在作为跨领域多模态策略学习在操作任务中的基准。
summary_zh: 本文提出HRDexDB——一个包含人类与多样化机械手高精度灵巧抓取序列的大规模多模态数据集。区别于现有数据集，HRDexDB系统收录了人手与多种仿生机械手对100类不同物体的抓取轨迹。通过融合前沿视觉方法及新型专用多相机系统，HRDexDB为操作主体与被操作物体提供了高精度时空三维真值运动数据。为促进物理交互研究，本数据集包含高分辨率触觉信号、同步多视角视频及第一人称视角视频流。该数据集涵盖1400次抓取实验（含成功与失败案例），每条数据均融合视觉、运动学与触觉模态信息。通过在同一目标物体上采集具有可比性的抓取动作，实现对人类灵巧操作与机器人执行过程的高度对齐记录，HRDexDB可为多模态策略学习及跨领域灵巧操控研究提供基准性支撑。

title: Switch: Learning Agile Skills Switching for Humanoid Robots
summary: Recent advancements in whole-body control through deep reinforcement learning have enabled humanoid robots to achieve remarkable progress in real-world chal lenging locomotion skills. However, existing approaches often struggle with flexible transitions between distinct skills, cre ating safety concerns and practical limitations. To address this challenge, we introduce a hierarchical multi-skill system, Switch, enabling seamless skill transitions at any moment. Our approach comprises three key components: (1) a Skill Graph (SG) that establishes potential cross-skill transitions based on kinematic similarity within multi-skill motion data, (2) a whole-body tracking policy trained on this skill graph through deep reinforcement learning, and (3) an online skill scheduler to drive the tracking policy for robust skill execution and smooth transitions. For skill switching or significant tracking deviations, the scheduler performs online graph search to find the optimal feasible path, which ensures efficient, stable, and real-time execution of diverse locomotion skills. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that Switch empowers humanoid to execute agile skill transitions with high success rates while maintaining strong motion imitation performance.
tldr: Switch enables humanoid robots to perform agile skill transitions between various locomotion skills using a hierarchical skill graph, tracking policy, and online scheduler, improving safety and versatility.
tldr_zh: Switch 通过一个分层的技能图、跟踪策略和在线调度器，使人形机器人能够执行不同运动技能之间的灵巧切换，提高了安全性和多功能性。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
通过深度强化学习的全身控制技术近期取得显著进展，使得人形机器人能够在现实复杂场景中实现卓越的运动技能。然而，现有方法往往难以在不同技能间灵活切换，存在安全隐患与实践局限。为应对这一挑战，我们提出一种分层多技能系统——Switch，能够在任意时刻实现无缝技能切换。该系统包含三个核心模块：（1）技能图谱，基于多技能运动数据中的运动学相似性建立潜在跨技能转换路径；（2）基于该图谱通过深度强化学习训练的全身跟踪策略；（3）在线技能调度器，用于驱动跟踪策略以实现鲁棒的技能执行与平滑过渡。当进行技能切换或出现显著跟踪偏差时，调度器通过在线图搜索寻找最优可行路径，从而确保多种运动技能的高效、稳定且实时执行。综合实验表明，Switch系统使人形机器人能以高成功率完成敏捷的技能切换，同时保持优异的运动模仿性能。

title: Differentiable Object Pose Connectivity Metrics for Regrasp Sequence Optimization
summary: Regrasp planning is often required when one pick-and-place cannot transfer an object from an initial pose to a goal pose while maintaining grasp feasibility. The main challenge is to reason about shared-grasp connectivity across intermediate poses, where discrete search becomes brittle. We propose an implicit multi-step regrasp planning framework based on differentiable pose sequence connectivity metrics. We model grasp feasibility under an object pose using an Energy-Based Model (EBM) and leverage energy additivity to construct a continuous energy landscape that measures pose-pair connectivity, enabling gradient-based optimization of intermediate object poses. An adaptive iterative deepening strategy is introduced to determine the minimum number of intermediate steps automatically. Experiments show that the proposed cost formulation provides smooth and informative gradients, improving planning robustness over other alternatives. They also demonstrate generalization to unseen grasp poses and cross-end-effector transfer, where a model trained with suction constraints can guide parallel gripper grasp manipulation. The multi-step planning results further highlight the effectiveness of adaptive deepening and minimum-step search.
tldr: A framework for multi-step regrasp planning using differentiable connectivity metrics between object poses, enabling gradient-based optimization and automatic step determination for robust manipulation.
tldr_zh: 提出一个基于可微分位姿连通性度量的多步重抓取规划框架，利用梯度优化和自适应深度策略实现鲁棒的机器人操作规划。
summary_zh:
摘要：
当单次抓取放置无法在保持抓取可行性的同时，将物体从初始位姿转移至目标位姿时，往往需要重新进行抓取规划。其核心挑战在于推断中间位姿间的共享抓取连通性，而离散搜索方法在此类问题上表现脆弱。我们提出了一种基于可微分位姿序列连通性度量的隐式多步骤重抓取规划框架。该方法利用基于能量模型（EBM）建立物体位姿下的抓取可行性模型，并通过能量可加性构建连续的能量场来度量位姿对之间的连通性，从而实现基于梯度的中间物体位姿优化。我们还引入了自适应迭代深化策略，以自动确定最小中间步骤数。实验表明，所提出的成本函数能够提供平滑且信息丰富的梯度，相比其他方法显著提升了规划的鲁棒性。同时，该方法展示了对于未见过抓取位姿的泛化能力以及跨末端执行器的迁移能力——例如，在吸盘约束下训练的模型能够有效指导平行夹爪的抓取操作。多步骤规划结果进一步验证了自适应深化策略与最小步数搜索机制的有效性。

title: World-Value-Action Model: Implicit Planning for Vision-Language-Action Systems
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for building embodied agents that ground perception and language into action. However, most existing approaches rely on direct action prediction, lacking the ability to reason over long-horizon trajectories and evaluate their consequences, which limits performance in complex decision-making tasks. In this work, we introduce World-Value-Action (WAV) model, a unified framework that enables implicit planning in VLA systems. Rather than performing explicit trajectory optimization, WAV model learn a structured latent representation of future trajectories conditioned on visual observations and language instructions. A learned world model predicts future states, while a trajectory value function evaluates their long-horizon utility. Action generation is then formulated as inference in this latent space, where the model progressively concentrates probability mass on high-value and dynamically feasible trajectories. We provide a theoretical perspective showing that planning directly in action space suffers from an exponential decay in the probability of feasible trajectories as the horizon increases. In contrast, latent-space inference reshapes the search distribution toward feasible regions, enabling efficient long-horizon decision making. Extensive simulations and real-world experiments demonstrate that the WAV model consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving significant improvements in task success rate, generalization ability, and robustness, especially in long-horizon and compositional scenarios.
tldr: Introduces a World-Value-Action (WAV) model for VLA systems, enabling implicit long-horizon planning via latent-space inference, improving performance in robotic and embodied tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出用于VLA系统的World-Value-Action (WAV)模型，通过潜在空间推理实现隐式长视野规划，提升了机器人和具身任务中的性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为构建具身智能体的一种有前景的范式，其将感知与语言映射到具体行动中。然而，现有方法大多依赖直接动作预测，缺乏对长时序轨迹进行推理和评估其后果的能力，这限制了在复杂决策任务中的表现。本文提出世界-价值-动作（WAV）模型，这是一个能够实现VLA系统隐式规划的通用框架。WAV模型不进行显式轨迹优化，而是学习以视觉观察和语言指令为条件的未来轨迹的结构化潜表示。通过学习的世界模型预测未来状态，并通过轨迹价值函数评估其长时序效用。动作生成则被建模为在此潜空间中的推断过程，模型逐步将概率质量集中在高价值和动态可行的轨迹上。我们从理论视角证明：直接在动作空间中进行规划会随着时间跨度的增加，面临可行轨迹概率呈指数衰减的问题。相比之下，潜空间推断能够将搜索分布重塑至可行区域，从而实现高效的长时序决策。大量仿真和真实世界实验表明，WAV模型持续优于现有先进方法，在任务成功率、泛化能力和鲁棒性方面取得显著提升，尤其在长时序和组合场景中表现突出。

title: Energy-based Regularization for Learning Residual Dynamics in Neural MPC for Omnidirectional Aerial Robots
summary: Data-driven Model Predictive Control (MPC) has lately been the core research subject in the field of control theory. The combination of an optimal control framework with deep learning paradigms opens up the possibility to accurately track control tasks without the need for complex analytical models. However, the system dynamics are often nuanced and the neural model lacks the potential to understand physical properties such as inertia and conservation of energy. In this work, we propose a novel energy-based regularization loss function which is applied to the training of a neural model that learns the residual dynamics of an omnidirectional aerial robot. Our energy-based regularization encourages the neural network to cause control corrections that stabilize the energy of the system. The residual dynamics are integrated into the MPC framework and improve the positional mean absolute error (MAE) over three real-world experiments by 23% compared to an analytical MPC. We also compare our method to a standard neural MPC implementation without regularization and primarily achieve a significantly increased flight stability implicitly due to the energy regularization and up to 15% lower MAE. Our code is available under: https://github.com/johanneskbl/jsk_aerial_robot/tree/develop/neural_MPC.
tldr: The paper introduces an energy-based regularization loss for training neural residual dynamics models to improve the stability and accuracy of Neural Model Predictive Control for omnidirectional aerial robots.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于能量的正则化损失函数，用于训练学习全向空中机器人残差动力学的神经模型，以提升神经模型预测控制的稳定性和精度。
summary_zh: 数据驱动的模型预测控制（MPC）近年来已成为控制理论领域的核心研究课题。将最优控制框架与深度学习范式相结合，为无需复杂解析模型即可精确跟踪控制任务开辟了可能性。然而，系统动力学往往具有细微差异，且神经网络模型难以理解诸如惯性和能量守恒等物理特性。本研究提出了一种基于能量的新型正则化损失函数，并将其应用于训练学习全向空中机器人残余动力学的神经网络模型。该能量正则化方法促使神经网络产生的控制修正能够稳定系统能量。残余动力学被整合到MPC框架中，经三次真实世界实验验证，其位置平均绝对误差（MAE）较传统解析模型预测控制降低了23%。此外，通过与未使用正则化的标准神经MPC实现进行对比，本方法凭借能量正则化机制显著提升了飞行稳定性（主要表现为隐性改进），并实现了最高15%的MAE降低。相关代码已在以下地址开源：https://github.com/johanneskbl/jsk_aerial_robot/tree/develop/neural_MPC。

title: DigiForest: Digital Analytics and Robotics for Sustainable Forestry
summary: Covering one third of Earth's land surface, forests are vital to global biodiversity, climate regulation, and human well-being. In Europe, forests and woodlands reach approximately 40% of land area, and the forestry sector is central to achieving the EU's climate neutrality and biodiversity goals; these emphasize sustainable forest management, increased use of long-lived wood products, and resilient forest ecosystems. To meet these goals and properly address their inherent challenges, current practices require further innovation. This chapter introduces DigiForest, a novel, large-scale precision forestry approach leveraging digital technologies and autonomous robotics. DigiForest is structured around four main components: (1) autonomous, heterogeneous mobile robots (aerial, legged, and marsupial) for tree-level data collection; (2) automated extraction of tree traits to build forest inventories; (3) a Decision Support System (DSS) for forecasting forest growth and supporting decision-making; and (4) low-impact selective logging using purpose-built autonomous harvesters. These technologies have been extensively validated in real-world conditions in several locations, including forests in Finland, the UK, and Switzerland.
tldr: This paper presents DigiForest, a precision forestry system that uses autonomous aerial, legged, and marsupial robots for data collection, inventory building, and selective logging, validated in real-world forests.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了DigiForest系统，一种利用自主空中、腿式和背负式机器人进行数据收集、森林清查和选择性采伐的精准林业方案，已在多国森林中进行实地验证。
summary_zh: 森林覆盖了地球陆地面积的三分之一，对全球生物多样性、气候调节和人类福祉至关重要。在欧洲，森林和林地约占陆地面积的40%，林业部门是实现欧盟气候中和与生物多样性目标的核心；这些目标强调可持续森林管理、增加长寿命木材产品的使用，以及具有韧性的森林生态系统。为实现这些目标并妥善应对其内在挑战，当前实践需要进一步创新。本章介绍了DigiForest，这是一种新颖的大规模精准林业方法，利用数字技术和自主机器人技术。DigiForest围绕四个主要组成部分构建：（1）用于树木级数据采集的自主异构移动机器人（空中、腿式和袋载式）；（2）自动提取树木性状以构建森林资源清单；（3）用于预测森林生长并支持决策的决策支持系统；（4）使用专用自主采伐机进行低影响选择性采伐。这些技术已在芬兰、英国和瑞士等多地的真实森林环境中进行了广泛验证。

title: Model-Based Reinforcement Learning Exploits Passive Body Dynamics for High-Performance Biped Robot Locomotion
summary: Embodiment is a significant keyword in recent machine learning fields. This study focused on the passive nature of the body of a biped robot to generate walking and running locomotion using model-based deep reinforcement learning. We constructed two models in a simulator, one with passive elements (e.g., springs) and the other, which is similar to general humanoids, without passive elements. The training of the model with passive elements was highly affected by the attractor of the system. This lead that although the trajectories quickly converged to limit cycles, it took a long time to obtain large rewards. However, thanks to the attractor-driven learning, the acquired locomotion was robust and energy-efficient. The results revealed that robots with passive elements could efficiently acquire high-performance locomotion by utilizing stable limit cycles generated through dynamic interaction between the body and ground. This study demonstrates the importance of implementing passive properties in the body for future embodied AI.
tldr: The paper uses model-based deep reinforcement learning to generate robust and energy-efficient walking/running locomotion for bipedal robots by exploiting passive body dynamics and stable limit cycles.
tldr_zh: 本研究利用基于模型的深度强化学习，通过利用双足机器人的被动身体动力学和稳定的极限环，生成稳健且节能的行走/跑步运动。
summary_zh: 体化是当前机器学习领域的一个重要关键词。本研究聚焦于双足机器人身体的被动特性，通过基于模型的深度强化学习生成行走和跑动步态。我们在仿真器中构建了两种模型：一种具有被动元件（如弹簧），另一种则采用类似通用仿人机器人的无被动元件设计。含被动元件模型的训练过程受到系统吸引子的显著影响，这导致虽然轨迹能快速收敛于极限环，但需较长时间才能获得高回报。然而，得益于吸引子驱动的学习机制，所获得的运动步态具备优异的鲁棒性和能量效率。研究结果表明，具备被动元件的机器人能够通过身体与地面动态相互作用产生的稳定极限环，高效习得高性能运动能力。本研究论证了在未来具身智能体中实现身体被动特性具有重要意义。

title: SpaceMind: A Modular and Self-Evolving Embodied Vision-Language Agent Framework for Autonomous On-orbit Servicing
summary: Autonomous on-orbit servicing demands embodied agents that perceive through visual sensors, reason about 3D spatial situations, and execute multi-phase tasks over extended horizons. We present SpaceMind, a modular and self-evolving vision-language model (VLM) agent framework that decomposes knowledge, tools, and reasoning into three independently extensible dimensions: skill modules with dynamic routing, Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools with configurable profiles, and injectable reasoning-mode skills. An MCP-Redis interface layer enables the same codebase to operate across simulation and physical hardware without modification, and a Skill Self-Evolution mechanism distills operational experience into persistent skill files without model fine-tuning. We validate SpaceMind through 192 closed-loop runs across five satellites, three task types, and two environments, a UE5 simulation and a physical laboratory, deliberately including degraded conditions to stress-test robustness. Under nominal conditions all modes achieve 90--100% navigation success; under degradation, the Prospective mode uniquely succeeds in search-and-approach tasks where other modes fail. A self-evolution study shows that the agent recovers from failure in four of six groups from a single failed episode, including complete failure to 100% success and inspection scores improving from 12 to 59 out of 100. Real-world validation confirms zero-code-modification transfer to a physical robot with 100% rendezvous success. Code: https://github.com/wuaodi/SpaceMind
tldr: SpaceMind is a modular and self-evolving embodied Vision-Language Model agent framework designed for autonomous on-orbit servicing, validated in simulation and on a physical robot, focusing on long-horizon spatial reasoning and robust task execution.
tldr_zh: SpaceMind 是一个模块化、自进化的具身视觉-语言模型智能体框架，用于自主在轨服务，在仿真和物理机器人上进行了验证，专注于长时程空间推理和鲁棒的任务执行。
summary_zh: 自主在轨服务需要具身智能体通过视觉传感器感知、理解三维空间态势，并执行长时跨度的多阶段任务。本文提出SpaceMind——一种模块化自进化的视觉语言模型（VLM）智能体框架，将知识、工具与推理解耦为三个可独立扩展的维度：具备动态路由机制的技能模块、支持可配置描述文件的模型上下文协议（MCP）工具库，以及可灵活注入的推理模式技能。通过MCP-Redis接口层，同一代码库无需修改即可在仿真环境与物理硬件中运行；技能自进化机制无需模型微调即可将操作经验固化为持久化技能文件。我们在五颗卫星、三类任务、两种环境（UE5仿真与物理实验室）中完成192次闭环实验验证，并特意引入退化条件以进行鲁棒性压力测试。在正常工况下，所有模式均实现90%-100%的导航成功率；在退化条件下，前瞻模式成为唯一能成功完成其他模式均失败的搜索逼近任务的方案。自进化研究表明，智能体能在六组实验中的四组里通过单次失败经验实现性能恢复，包括从完全失败提升至100%成功，且检测评分从12分提升至59分（满分100）。真实世界验证证实，该系统无需代码修改即可迁移至物理机器人，并实现100%交会成功率。代码地址：https://github.com/wuaodi/SpaceMind

title: CART: Context-Aware Terrain Adaptation using Temporal Sequence Selection for Legged Robots
summary: Animals in nature combine multiple modalities, such as sight and feel, to perceive terrain and develop an understanding of how to walk on uneven terrain in a stable manner. Similarly, legged robots need to develop their ability to stably walk on complex terrains by developing an understanding of the relationship between vision and proprioception. Most current terrain adaptation methods are susceptible to failure on complex, off-road terrain as they rely on prior experience, particularly observations from a vision sensor. This experience-based learning often creates a Visual-Texture Paradox between what has been seen and how it actually feels. In this work, we introduce CART, a high-level controller built on a context-aware terrain adaptation approach that integrates proprioception and exteroception from onboard sensing to achieve a robust understanding of terrain. We evaluate our method on multiple terrains using an ANYmal-C robot on the IsaacSim simulator and a Boston Dynamics SPOT robot for our real-world experiments. To evaluate the learned contextual terrain properties, we adapt vibrational stability on the base of the robot as a metric. We compare CART with various state-of-the-art baselines equipped with multimodal sensing in both simulation and the real world. CART achieves an average success rate improvement of 5% over all baselines in simulation and improves the overall stability up to 45% and 24% in the real world without increasing the time taken by the robot to accomplish locomotion tasks.
tldr: Presents CART, a high-level controller for legged robots that integrates vision and proprioception for robust terrain adaptation, improving locomotion stability.
tldr_zh: 提出CART，一种用于腿式机器人的高级控制器，通过整合视觉和本体感知实现稳健的地形适应，提高运动稳定性。
summary_zh: 自然界中的动物通过结合视觉与触觉等多种感知方式，来感知地形并形成如何在崎岖地形上稳定行走的认知。同样，腿式机器人也需要通过理解视觉与本体感知之间的关系，来发展其在复杂地形上稳定行走的能力。当前大多数地形适应方法依赖于先验经验，尤其是视觉传感器的观测数据，这使它们在复杂越野地形上容易失效。这种基于经验的学习往往在所见与所感之间形成一种"视觉-触觉悖论"。本研究提出CART——一种基于情境感知地形适应方法的高层控制器，它通过整合来自机载传感器的本体感知与外部感知，实现对地形特性的鲁棒理解。我们在IsaacSim仿真器中使用ANYmal-C机器人，并在真实世界实验中采用波士顿动力SPOT机器人，对多种地形进行了方法评估。为评价学习到的情境化地形特性，我们以机器人底盘的振动稳定性作为衡量指标。在仿真与真实环境中，我们将CART与多种配备多模态感知的先进基线方法进行比较。结果表明：CART在仿真环境中平均成功率较所有基线提升5%，在真实世界中总体稳定性最高提升45%与24%，同时未增加机器人完成运动任务所需的时间。

title: Abstract Sim2Real through Approximate Information States
summary: In recent years, reinforcement learning (RL) has shown remarkable success in robotics when a fast and accurate simulator is available for a given task. When using RL and simulation, more simulator realism is generally beneficial but becomes harder to obtain as robots are deployed in increasingly complex and widescale domains. In such settings, simulators will likely fail to model all relevant details of a given target task and this observation motivates the study of sim2real with simulators that leave out key task details. In this paper, we formalize and study the abstract sim2real problem: given an abstract simulator that models a target task at a coarse level of abstraction, how can we train a policy with RL in the abstract simulator and successfully transfer it to the real-world? Our first contribution is to formalize this problem using the language of state abstraction from the RL literature. This framing shows that an abstract simulator can be grounded to match the target task if the grounded abstract dynamics take the history of states into account. Based on the formalism, we then introduce a method that uses real-world task data to correct the dynamics of the abstract simulator. We then show that this method enables successful policy transfer both in sim2sim and sim2real evaluation.
tldr: This paper formalizes and studies the abstract sim2real problem, where a coarse abstract simulator is used to train RL policies, and proposes a method to correct the simulator's dynamics using real-world data to enable successful policy transfer to the real world.
tldr_zh: 本文形式化并研究了抽象模拟到现实（abstract sim2real）问题，其中使用粗粒度的抽象模拟器训练强化学习策略，并提出一种利用真实世界数据修正模拟器动力学的方法，以实现策略到现实世界的成功迁移。
summary_zh: 近年来，强化学习（RL）在机器人领域展现出显著成效，尤其是在具备快速且精准的任务模拟器时。当结合强化学习与仿真技术时，提高模拟器的真实度通常有助于提升效果，但随着机器人在日益复杂和大规模场景中的部署，实现更高真实度变得愈发困难。在此类场景中，模拟器往往难以涵盖目标任务的所有关键细节，这一现象促使我们着眼于研究那些忽略关键任务细节的模拟器的“仿真到现实”（sim2real）问题。本文旨在形式化并探究“抽象模拟到现实”问题：给定一个在粗粒度抽象层面建模目标任务的抽象模拟器，我们应如何在该模拟器中利用强化学习训练策略，并成功将其迁移至现实世界？我们的首个贡献是利用强化学习文献中的状态抽象语言对该问题进行形式化描述。该框架表明，若接地后的抽象动态过程能考虑历史状态，则抽象模拟器可通过接地匹配目标任务。基于此形式化框架，我们进而提出一种利用现实世界任务数据修正抽象模拟器动态过程的方法。实验表明，该方法在“仿真到仿真”与“仿真到现实”评估中均能成功实现策略迁移。

title: Vision-Based Safe Human-Robot Collaboration with Uncertainty Guarantees
summary: We propose a framework for vision-based human pose estimation and motion prediction that gives conformal prediction guarantees for certifiably safe human-robot collaboration. Our framework combines aleatoric uncertainty estimation with OOD detection for high probabilistic confidence. To integrate our pipeline in certifiable safety frameworks, we propose conformal prediction sets for human motion predictions with high, valid confidence. We evaluate our pipeline on recorded human motion data and a real-world human-robot collaboration setting.
tldr: Proposes a vision-based framework for safe human-robot collaboration using conformal prediction to provide uncertainty guarantees for human pose estimation and motion prediction.
tldr_zh: 提出一个基于视觉的安全人机协作框架，利用共形预测为人体姿态估计和运动预测提供不确定性保证。
summary_zh: 本研究提出一种基于视觉的人体姿态估计与运动预测框架，该框架能够为可认证安全的人机协作任务提供符合性预测保证。通过将认知不确定性估计与分布外检测相结合，我们的框架实现了高概率置信度。为将流程集成至可认证安全框架中，我们提出了具有高效有效置信度的人体运动预测符合性预测集。该框架已在记录的人体运动数据及真实世界人机协作场景中完成验证评估。

title: Trajectory Planning for a Multi-UAV Rigid-Payload Cascaded Transportation System Based on Enhanced Tube-RRT*
summary: This paper presents a two-stage trajectory planning framework for a multi-UAV rigid-payload cascaded transportation system, aiming to address planning challenges in densely cluttered environments. In Stage I, an Enhanced Tube-RRT* algorithm is developed by integrating active hybrid sampling and an adaptive expansion strategy, enabling rapid generation of a safe and feasible virtual tube in environments with dense obstacles. Moreover, a trajectory smoothness cost is explicitly incorporated into the edge cost to reduce excessive turns and thereby mitigate cable-induced oscillations. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed Enhanced Tube-RRT* achieves a higher success rate and effective sampling rate than mixed-sampling Tube-RRT* (STube-RRT*) and adaptive-extension Tube-RRT* (AETube-RRT*), while producing a shorter optimal path with a smaller cumulative turning angle. In Stage II, a convex quadratic program is formulated by considering payload translational and rotational dynamics, cable tension constraints, and collision-safety constraints, yielding a smooth, collision-free desired payload trajectory. Finally, a centralized geometric control scheme is applied to the cascaded system to validate the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed planning framework, offering a practical solution for payload attitude maneuvering in densely cluttered environments.
tldr: This paper presents a two-stage trajectory planning framework using an enhanced sampling-based algorithm (Tube-RRT*) and geometric control for a multi-UAV system transporting a rigid payload in cluttered environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于多无人机刚性负载级联运输系统的两阶段轨迹规划框架，采用增强型Tube-RRT*算法和几何控制，以在密集障碍环境中实现安全、平滑的负载运输。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种面向多无人机刚性载荷级联运输系统的两阶段轨迹规划框架，旨在解决密集障碍环境中的规划难题。第一阶段通过融合主动混合采样与自适应扩展策略，提出增强型Tube-RRT*算法，能够在密集障碍环境中快速生成安全可行的虚拟管道。同时，在路径代价函数中显式引入轨迹平滑度成本，以减少过度转向从而抑制缆绳引发的振荡。仿真结果表明，相较于混合采样Tube-RRT*（STube-RRT*）与自适应扩展Tube-RRT*（AETube-RRT*），所提出的增强型Tube-RRT*算法具有更高的成功率和有效采样率，并能生成累积转弯角度更小的更优路径。第二阶段通过综合考虑载荷平动与转动动力学、缆绳张力约束及碰撞安全约束，构建凸二次规划问题，生成平滑无碰撞的期望载荷轨迹。最后，将集中式几何控制方案应用于级联系统，验证了所提规划框架的有效性与可行性，为密集障碍环境下的载荷姿态机动提供了实用解决方案。

title: ADAPT: Benchmarking Commonsense Planning under Unspecified Affordance Constraints
summary: Intelligent embodied agents should not simply follow instructions, as real-world environments often involve unexpected conditions and exceptions. However, existing methods usually focus on directly executing instructions, without considering whether the target objects can actually be manipulated, meaning they fail to assess available affordances. To address this limitation, we introduce DynAfford, a benchmark that evaluates embodied agents in dynamic environments where object affordances may change over time and are not specified in the instruction. DynAfford requires agents to perceive object states, infer implicit preconditions, and adapt their actions accordingly. To enable this capability, we introduce ADAPT, a plug-and-play module that augments existing planners with explicit affordance reasoning. Experiments demonstrate that incorporating ADAPT significantly improves robustness and task success across both seen and unseen environments. We also show that a domain-adapted, LoRA-finetuned vision-language model used as the affordance inference backend outperforms a commercial LLM (GPT-4o), highlighting the importance of task-aligned affordance grounding.
tldr: This paper introduces ADAPT, a benchmark and plug-in module for commonsense planning in dynamic embodied environments, where agents must reason about unspecified object affordances. It shows improved task success by augmenting planners with an explicit affordance reasoning module and a fine-tuned vision-language model for grounding.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了ADAPT，一个用于动态具身环境中常识性规划的基准测试和即插即用模块。智能体必须对未指定的物体可供性进行推理，该模块通过增强显式可供性推理和微调的视觉-语言模型，提高了任务成功率。
summary_zh: 智能体代理不应简单地遵循指令，因为现实环境常包含意外状况与例外情况。然而现有方法通常聚焦于直接执行指令，未考虑目标物体是否实际可操作，即缺乏对可供性评估的能力。为突破此局限，我们提出DynAfford基准测试框架，用于评估动态环境中的具身智能体——这类环境中物体的可供性可能随时间变化且未在指令中明示。DynAfford要求智能体感知物体状态、推理隐含前提条件并相应调整行动策略。为实现该能力，我们开发了ADAPT即插即用模块，通过显式可供性推理增强现有规划器。实验表明，集成ADAPT模块能显著提升智能体在已知与未知环境中的鲁棒性与任务成功率。研究还发现，采用领域适配的LoRA微调视觉语言模型作为可供性推理后端，其表现优于商用大语言模型（GPT-4o），这凸显了任务对齐的可供性 grounding 机制的重要性。

title: Keep It CALM: Toward Calibration-Free Kilometer-Level SLAM with Visual Geometry Foundation Models via an Assistant Eye
summary: Visual Geometry Foundation Models (VGFMs) demonstrate remarkable zero-shot capabilities in local reconstruction. However, deploying them for kilometer-level Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) remains challenging. In such scenarios, current approaches mainly rely on linear transforms (e.g., Sim3 and SL4) for sub-map alignment, while we argue that a single linear transform is fundamentally insufficient to model the complex, non-linear geometric distortions inherent in VGFM outputs. Forcing such rigid alignment leads to the rapid accumulation of uncorrected residuals, eventually resulting in significant trajectory drift and map divergence. To address these limitations, we present CAL2M (Calibration-free Assistant-eye based Large-scale Localization and Mapping), a plug-and-play framework compatible with arbitrary VGFMs. Distinct from traditional systems, CAL2M introduces an "assistant eye" solely to leverage the prior of constant physical spacing, effectively eliminating scale ambiguity without any temporal or spatial pre-calibration. Furthermore, leveraging the assumption of accurate feature matching, we propose an epipolar-guided intrinsic and pose correction model. Supported by an online intrinsic search module, it can effectively rectify rotation and translation errors caused by inaccurate intrinsics through fundamental matrix decomposition. Finally, to ensure accurate mapping, we introduce a globally consistent mapping strategy based on anchor propagation. By constructing and fusing anchors across the trajectory, we establish a direct local-to-global mapping relationship. This enables the application of nonlinear transformations to elastically align sub-maps, effectively eliminating geometric misalignments and ensuring a globally consistent reconstruction. The source code of CAL2M will be publicly available at https://github.com/IRMVLab/CALM.
tldr: The paper proposes CAL2M, a calibration-free framework for large-scale visual SLAM using Visual Geometry Foundation Models, addressing scale ambiguity and geometric distortion with an assistant eye and non-linear sub-map alignment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了CAL2M，一个用于大规模视觉SLAM的无校准框架，利用视觉几何基础模型，通过辅助眼和非线性子地图配准来解决尺度歧义和几何畸变问题。
summary_zh: 视觉几何基础模型（VGFMs）在局部重建任务中展现出卓越的零样本能力。然而，将其应用于公里级同步定位与建图（SLAM）仍面临挑战。在此类场景中，现有方法主要依赖线性变换（如Sim3和SL4）进行子图对齐，而我们认为单一线性变换本质上不足以建模VGFM输出中固有的复杂非线性几何畸变。强制进行此类刚性对齐会导致未校正残差快速累积，最终引发严重的轨迹漂移与地图发散。为应对这些局限，我们提出了CAL2M（基于无标定辅助视角的大规模定位与建图框架），这是一个与任意VGFMs兼容的即插即用框架。与传统系统不同，CAL2M引入“辅助视角”仅用于利用恒定物理间距的先验信息，无需任何时间或空间预标定即可有效消除尺度模糊性。此外，基于精确特征匹配的假设，我们提出了一种极线约束引导的内参与位姿校正模型。该模型通过在线内参搜索模块的支持，能够基于基础矩阵分解有效校正由内参不准确引起的旋转与平移误差。最后，为保障建图精度，我们提出了一种基于锚点传播的全局一致性建图策略。通过在轨迹上构建并融合锚点，我们建立了直接的局部到全局建图关系。这使得非线性变换得以应用于子图的弹性对齐，有效消除几何错位，确保重建结果的全局一致性。CAL2M的源代码将公开于https://github.com/IRMVLab/CALM。

title: CT-VIR: Continuous-Time Visual-Inertial-Ranging Fusion for Indoor Localization with Sparse Anchors
summary: Visual-inertial odometry (VIO) is widely used for mobile robot localization, but its long-term accuracy degrades without global constraints. Incorporating ranging sensors such as ultra-wideband (UWB) can mitigate drift; however, high-accuracy ranging usually requires well-deployed anchors, which is difficult to ensure in narrow or low-power environments. Moreover, most existing visual-inertial-ranging (VIR) fusion methods rely on discrete time-based filtering or optimization, making it difficult to balance positioning accuracy, trajectory consistency, and fusion efficiency under asynchronous multi-sensor sampling. To address these issues, we propose a spline-based continuous-time state estimation method for VIR fusion localization. In the preprocessing stage, VIO motion priors and UWB ranging measurements are used to construct virtual anchors and reject outliers, thereby alleviating geometric degeneration and improving range reliability. In the estimation stage, the pose trajectory is parameterized in continuous time using a B-spline, while inertial, visual, and ranging constraints are formulated as factors in a sliding-window graph. The spline control points, together with a small set of auxiliary parameters, are then jointly optimized to obtain a continuous-time trajectory estimate. Evaluations on public datasets and real-world experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and practical potential of the proposed approach.
tldr: This paper proposes a continuous-time fusion method for visual-inertial-ranging data to improve the long-term accuracy and robustness of indoor mobile robot localization, especially in environments with sparse anchor deployment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种连续时间视觉-惯性-测距融合方法，用于提高移动机器人在稀疏锚点环境下的室内定位长期精度和鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 视觉惯性里程计（VIO）广泛用于移动机器人定位，但在缺乏全局约束的情况下其长期精度会下降。引入超宽带（UWB）等测距传感器可缓解漂移问题，然而高精度测距通常需要精心部署的锚点，这在狭窄或低功耗环境中难以保证。此外，现有的大多数视觉-惯性-测距（VIR）融合方法依赖于基于离散时间的滤波或优化框架，在异步多传感器采样条件下难以兼顾定位精度、轨迹一致性与融合效率。针对这些问题，我们提出了一种基于样条的连续时间状态估计方法用于VIR融合定位。在预处理阶段，利用VIO运动先验与UWB测距观测构建虚拟锚点并剔除异常值，从而缓解几何退化问题并提升测距可靠性。在估计阶段，采用B样条对位姿轨迹进行连续时间参数化，同时将惯性、视觉与测距约束建模为滑动窗口图优化中的因子。通过联合优化样条控制点与少量辅助参数，最终获得连续时间的轨迹估计结果。在公开数据集和真实环境实验中的评估验证了该方法的有效性与实用潜力。

title: RL-STPA: Adapting System-Theoretic Hazard Analysis for Safety-Critical Reinforcement Learning
summary: As reinforcement learning (RL) deployments expand into safety-critical domains, existing evaluation methods fail to systematically identify hazards arising from the black-box nature of neural network enabled policies and distributional shift between training and deployment. This paper introduces Reinforcement Learning System-Theoretic Process Analysis (RL-STPA), a framework that adapts conventional STPA's systematic hazard analysis to address RL's unique challenges through three key contributions: hierarchical subtask decomposition using both temporal phase analysis and domain expertise to capture emergent behaviors, coverage-guided perturbation testing that explores the sensitivity of state-action spaces, and iterative checkpoints that feed identified hazards back into training through reward shaping and curriculum design. We demonstrate RL-STPA in the safety-critical test case of autonomous drone navigation and landing, revealing potential loss scenarios that can be missed by standard RL evaluations. The proposed framework provides practitioners with a toolkit for systematic hazard analysis, quantitative metrics for safety coverage assessment, and actionable guidelines for establishing operational safety bounds. While RL-STPA cannot provide formal guarantees for arbitrary neural policies, it offers a practical methodology for systematically evaluating and improving RL safety and robustness in safety-critical applications where exhaustive verification methods remain intractable.
tldr: This paper proposes RL-STPA, a safety analysis framework adapting System-Theoretic Process Analysis to identify hazards in reinforcement learning systems, with a demonstration on autonomous drone navigation and landing.
tldr_zh: 本文提出RL-STPA框架，将系统理论过程分析适配于强化学习系统以进行危险分析，并在无人机自主导航与着陆案例中进行了演示。
summary_zh: 随着强化学习（RL）在安全关键领域的应用日益广泛，现有评估方法难以系统性地识别由神经网络策略的“黑箱”特性以及训练与部署间分布偏移所引发的潜在危险。本文提出了强化学习系统理论过程分析（RL-STPA）框架，该框架借鉴传统STPA的系统性危害分析方法，通过三项核心创新应对强化学习的独特挑战：结合时间阶段分析与领域知识的分层子任务分解，以捕捉涌现行为；覆盖度引导的扰动测试，以探索状态-动作空间的敏感性；以及通过奖励塑造和课程设计将识别出的危害反馈至训练过程的迭代检查点。我们在自主无人机导航与降落这一安全关键测试案例中验证了RL-STPA，揭示了标准强化学习评估可能遗漏的潜在失效场景。所提出的框架为从业者提供了一套系统性危害分析工具包、安全覆盖评估的量化指标，以及建立操作安全边界的具体指导原则。虽然RL-STPA无法为任意神经网络策略提供形式化保证，但在当前穷举验证方法仍不可行的安全关键应用中，它提供了一种系统评估并提升强化学习安全性与鲁棒性的实用方法。

title: Blazing the trails before beating the path: Sample-efficient Monte-Carlo planning
summary: You are a robot and you live in a Markov decision process (MDP) with a finite or an infinite number of transitions from state-action to next states. You got brains and so you plan before you act. Luckily, your roboparents equipped you with a generative model to do some Monte-Carlo planning. The world is waiting for you and you have no time to waste. You want your planning to be efficient. Sample-efficient. Indeed, you want to exploit the possible structure of the MDP by exploring only a subset of states reachable by following near-optimal policies. You want guarantees on sample complexity that depend on a measure of the quantity of near-optimal states. You want something, that is an extension of Monte-Carlo sampling (for estimating an expectation) to problems that alternate maximization (over actions) and expectation (over next states). But you do not want to StOP with exponential running time, you want something simple to implement and computationally efficient. You want it all and you want it now. You want TrailBlazer.
tldr: The paper proposes a new Monte-Carlo planning algorithm that focuses computational effort on near-optimal states to improve sample efficiency, explicitly aiming for robot control in MDPs.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种新的蒙特卡洛规划算法，将计算资源集中在近优状态上以提高样本效率，并明确面向机器人控制。
summary_zh:
摘要：
你是一个机器人，生活在一个马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中，其中从状态-行动到下一个状态的转移可能是有限的，也可能是无限的。你拥有智慧，因此在行动之前会进行规划。幸运的是，你的机器人父母为你配备了一个生成模型，用于进行蒙特卡洛规划。世界正等待着你，你没有时间可以浪费。你希望规划过程高效，即样本高效。事实上，你希望通过仅探索遵循接近最优策略可到达的状态子集，来利用MDP可能存在的结构。你需要关于样本复杂度的保证，这取决于接近最优状态数量的度量。你需要的是一种将蒙特卡洛采样（用于估计期望）扩展到交替进行最大化（对行动）和期望（对下一个状态）问题的方法。但你不希望因指数运行时间而停止，你希望方法易于实现且计算高效。你既想全都要，又想立刻得到。你需要的正是TrailBlazer。

title: NEAT-NC: NEAT guided Navigation Cells for Robot Path Planning
summary: To navigate a space, the brain makes an internal representation of the environment using different cells such as place cells, grid cells, head direction cells, border cells, and speed cells. All these cells, along with sensory inputs, enable an organism to explore the space around it. Inspired by these biological principles, we developed NEATNC, a Neuro-Evolution of Augmenting Topology guided Navigation Cells. The goal of the paper is to improve NEAT algorithm performance in path planning in dynamic environments using spatial cognitive cells. This approach uses navigation cells as inputs and evolves recurrent neural networks, representing the hippocampus part of the brain. The performance of the proposed algorithm is evaluated in different static and dynamic scenarios. This study highlights NEAT's adaptability to complex and different environments, showcasing the utility of biological theories. This suggests that our approach is well-suited for real-time dynamic path planning for robotics and games.
tldr: This paper introduces NEAT-NC, a path planning algorithm that uses neuro-evolution of recurrent neural networks inspired by biological navigation cells, evaluated in static and dynamic environments for robotics and games.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为NEAT-NC的路径规划算法，该方法受生物导航细胞启发，通过神经进化技术优化循环神经网络，并在静态和动态环境中进行了评估，适用于机器人及游戏领域。
summary_zh: 为了在空间中导航，大脑利用位置细胞、网格细胞、头朝向细胞、边界细胞及速度细胞等不同细胞，构建出对环境的内部表征。这些细胞与感觉输入共同作用，使生物体能够探索周围空间。受此生物学原理启发，我们开发了NEATNC算法，即一种由增强拓扑神经进化引导的导航细胞模型。本文的目标是利用空间认知细胞，提升NEAT算法在动态环境路径规划中的性能。该方法以导航细胞作为输入，并演化出代表大脑海马体结构的递归神经网络。我们在多种静态与动态场景中对所提算法性能进行了评估。本研究凸显了NEAT算法对复杂多变环境的适应性，同时展示了生物学理论的实际应用价值。结果表明，该方案非常适用于机器人及游戏领域的实时动态路径规划任务。

title: 4D Radar Gaussian Modeling and Scan Matching with RCS
summary: 4D millimeter-wave (mmWave) radars are increasingly used in robotics, as they offer robustness against adverse environmental conditions. Besides the usual XYZ position, they provide Doppler velocity measurements as well as Radar Cross Section (RCS) information for every point. While Doppler is widely used to filter out dynamic points, RCS is often overlooked and not usually used in modeling and scan matching processes. Building on previous 3D Gaussian modeling and scan matching work, we propose incorporating the physical behavior of RCS in the model, in order to further enrich the summarized information about the scene, and improve the scan matching process.
tldr: This paper proposes a novel method to incorporate Radar Cross Section (RCS) information into Gaussian modeling and scan matching for 4D radars, aiming to improve scene representation and scan matching accuracy in robotic applications.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种新方法，将雷达截面（RCS）信息整合到4D雷达的高斯建模和扫描匹配中，旨在改善机器人应用中的场景表示和扫描匹配精度。
summary_zh: 4D毫米波雷达因其在恶劣环境下的鲁棒性，在机器人领域中的应用日益广泛。除了常见的XYZ位置信息外，它还能为每个点提供多普勒速度测量以及雷达散射截面（RCS）信息。尽管多普勒速度被广泛用于滤除动态点，但RCS信息常被忽视，通常未在建模与扫描匹配过程中得到利用。基于此前关于3D高斯建模与扫描匹配的研究，我们提出在模型中引入RCS的物理特性，以进一步丰富场景的概括信息，并优化扫描匹配过程。

title: BIEVR-LIO: Robust LiDAR-Inertial Odometry through Bump-Image-Enhanced Voxel Maps
summary: Reliable odometry is essential for mobile robots as they increasingly enter more challenging environments, which often contain little information to constrain point cloud registration, resulting in degraded LiDAR-Inertial Odometry (LIO) accuracy or even divergence. To address this, we present BIEVR-LIO, a novel approach designed specifically to exploit subtle variations in the available geometry for improved robustness. We propose a high-resolution map representation that stores surfaces as compact voxel-wise oriented height images. This representation can directly be used for registration without the calculation of intermediate geometric primitives while still supporting efficient updates. Since informative geometry is often sparsely distributed in the environment, we further propose a map-informed point sampling strategy to focus registration on geometrically informative regions, improving robustness in uninformative environments while reducing computational cost compared to global high-resolution sampling. Experiments across multiple sensors, platforms, and environments demonstrates state-of-the-art performance in well-constrained scenes and substantial improvements in challenging scenarios where baseline methods diverge. Additionally, we demonstrate that the fine-grained geometry captured by BIEVR-LIO can be used for downstream tasks such as elevation mapping for robot locomotion.
tldr: Presents a robust LiDAR-inertial odometry method using a voxel-wise height image map and a map-informed point sampling strategy to improve performance in geometrically uninformative environments, with evaluation for robot locomotion.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种鲁棒的激光雷达-惯性里程计方法，通过体素级高度图像地图和地图引导的点采样策略，提高了在几何信息匮乏环境中的性能，并评估了其在机器人运动规划中的应用。
summary_zh: 可靠的里程计对于移动机器人至关重要，随着它们越来越多地进入更具挑战性的环境，这些环境通常包含很少的信息来约束点云配准，导致激光雷达惯性里程计（LIO）精度下降甚至发散。为解决这一问题，我们提出了BIEVR-LIO，这是一种专门设计的方法，旨在利用可用几何中的细微变化以提高鲁棒性。我们提出了一种高分辨率地图表示，将表面存储为紧凑的体素级定向高度图像。这种表示可以直接用于配准，而无需计算中间几何基元，同时仍支持高效更新。由于信息丰富的几何结构通常在环境中分布稀疏，我们进一步提出了一种基于地图的点采样策略，将配准重点集中在几何信息丰富的区域，从而提高在无信息环境中的鲁棒性，同时与全局高分辨率采样相比降低计算成本。跨多个传感器、平台和环境的实验表明，在约束良好的场景中具有先进的性能，并在基线方法失效的挑战性场景中取得了显著改进。此外，我们还证明BIEVR-LIO捕获的细粒度几何可用于下游任务，如机器人运动的高程映射。

title: Constraint-based Pre-training: From Structured Constraints to Scalable Model Initialization
summary: The pre-training and fine-tuning paradigm has become the dominant approach for model adaptation. However, conventional pre-training typically yields models at a fixed scale, whereas practical deployment often requires models of varying sizes, exposing its limitations when target model scales differ from those used during pre-training. To address this, we propose an innovative constraint-based pre-training paradigm that imposes structured constraints during pre-training to disentangle size-agnostic knowledge into reusable weight templates, while assigning size-specific adaptation to lightweight weight scalers, thereby reformulating variable-sized model initialization as a multi-task adaptation problem. Within this paradigm, we further introduce WeiT, which employs Kronecker-based constraints to regularize the pre-training process. Specifically, model parameters are represented as compositions of weight templates via concatenation and weighted aggregation, with adaptive connections governed by lightweight weight scalers whose parameters are learned from limited data. This design enables flexible and efficient construction of model weights across diverse downstream scales. Extensive experiments demonstrate the efficiency and effectiveness of WeiT, achieving state-of-the-art performance in initializing models with varying depths and widths across a broad range of perception and embodied learning tasks, including Image Classification, Image Generation, and Embodied Control. Moreover, its effectiveness generalizes to both Transformer-based and Convolution-based architectures, consistently enabling faster convergence and improved performance even under full training.
tldr: This paper proposes a novel pre-training paradigm that uses structured constraints to disentangle size-agnostic knowledge into reusable templates, enabling efficient initialization of models at varying scales. It claims effectiveness across a broad range of tasks, including Embodied Control.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种新颖的预训练范式，利用结构化约束将尺寸无关的知识解耦为可重用的权重模板，从而高效初始化不同规模的模型。据称该方法在包括具身控制在内的多种任务上均有效。
summary_zh: 预训练与微调范式已成为模型适配的主流方法。然而，传统的预训练通常生成固定规模的模型，而实际部署常需要不同尺寸的模型，当目标模型规模与预训练所用规模不一致时，其局限性便暴露出来。为此，我们提出一种基于约束的创新预训练范式，通过在预训练过程中施加结构化约束，将尺寸无关知识解耦为可复用的权重模板，同时将尺寸相关的适配任务交由轻量级权重缩放器处理，从而将变尺寸模型初始化问题重构为多任务适配问题。在这一范式下，我们进一步引入WeiT方法，采用基于Kronecker积的约束对预训练过程进行正则化。具体而言，模型参数通过拼接与加权聚合表示为权重模板的组合，并由轻量级权重缩放器控制自适应连接——其参数仅需从有限数据中学习。该设计能够灵活高效地构建适用于不同下游规模的模型权重。大量实验验证了WeiT的高效性与有效性，在包括图像分类、图像生成和具身控制在内的广泛感知与具身学习任务中，为不同深度与宽度的模型初始化实现了最先进的性能表现。此外，该方法的有效性可推广至基于Transformer和基于卷积的架构，即使在完整训练条件下，也能持续实现更快的收敛速度与更优的性能表现。

title: An Intelligent Robotic and Bio-Digestor Framework for Smart Waste Management
summary: Rapid urbanization and continuous population growth have made municipal solid waste management increasingly challenging. These challenges highlight the need for smarter and automated waste management solutions. This paper presents the design and evaluation of an integrated waste management framework that combines two connected systems, a robotic waste segregation module and an optimized bio-digestor. The robotic waste segregation system uses a MyCobot 280 Jetson Nano robotic arm along with YOLOv8 object detection and robot operating system (ROS)-based path planning to identify and sort waste in real time. It classifies waste into four different categories with high precision, reducing the need for manual intervention. After segregation, the biodegradable waste is transferred to a bio-digestor system equipped with multiple sensors. These sensors continuously monitor key parameters, including temperature, pH, pressure, and motor revolutions per minute. The Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm, combined with a regression model, is used to dynamically adjust system parameters. This intelligent optimization approach ensures stable operation and maximizes digestion efficiency under varying environmental conditions. System testing under dynamic conditions demonstrates a sorting accuracy of 98% along with highly efficient biological conversion. The proposed framework offers a scalable, intelligent, and practical solution for modern waste management, making it suitable for both residential and industrial applications.
tldr: The paper proposes an integrated smart waste management system combining a robotic arm for waste sorting using YOLOv8 and ROS, and an optimized bio-digestor with PSO control.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种集成智能废物管理系统，结合了使用YOLOv8和ROS进行废物分拣的机械臂，以及采用PSO控制的优化生物消化器。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
快速城市化与人口持续增长使得城市固体废物管理日益面临挑战，这些挑战凸显了对更智能、自动化废物管理解决方案的需求。本文提出并评估了一种集成废物管理框架，该框架结合了两种互联系统：机器人废物分拣模块与优化的生物消化装置。机器人分拣系统采用MyCobot 280 Jetson Nano机械臂，结合YOLOv8目标检测和基于机器人操作系统（ROS）的路径规划技术，实现实时废物识别与分类。该系统能够高精度地将废物分为四类，显著减少人工干预需求。分拣后，可生物降解的废物被输送至配备多传感器的生物消化系统中。这些传感器持续监测关键参数，包括温度、pH值、压力和电机转速。研究采用粒子群优化（PSO）算法结合回归模型动态调整系统参数，通过智能优化方法确保系统在不同环境条件下的稳定运行，并最大化消化效率。动态条件下的系统测试表明，该框架实现了98%的分拣准确率和高效生物转化率。所提出的框架为现代废物管理提供了可扩展、智能化且实用的解决方案，适用于住宅和工业应用场景。

title: Dual Pose-Graph Semantic Localization for Vision-Based Autonomous Drone Racing
summary: Autonomous drone racing demands robust real-time localization under extreme conditions: high-speed flight, aggressive maneuvers, and payload-constrained platforms that often rely on a single camera for perception. Existing visual SLAM systems, while effective in general scenarios, struggle with motion blur and feature instability inherent to racing dynamics, and do not exploit the structured nature of racing environments. In this work, we present a dual pose-graph architecture that fuses odometry with semantic detections for robust localization. A temporary graph accumulates multiple gate observations between keyframes and optimizes them into a single refined constraint per landmark, which is then promoted to a persistent main graph. This design preserves the information richness of frequent detections while preventing graph growth from degrading real-time performance. The system is designed to be sensor-agnostic, although in this work we validate it using monocular visual-inertial odometry and visual gate detections. Experimental evaluation on the TII-RATM dataset shows a 56% to 74% reduction in ATE compared to standalone VIO, while an ablation study confirms that the dual-graph architecture achieves 10% to 12% higher accuracy than a single-graph baseline at identical computational cost. Deployment in the A2RL competition demonstrated that the system performs real-time onboard localization during flight, reducing the drift of the odometry baseline by up to 4.2 m per lap.
tldr: A novel dual pose-graph architecture fuses visual odometry and semantic gate detections for robust, real-time localization in autonomous drone racing, significantly outperforming standard VIO in high-speed scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的双重姿态图架构，融合视觉里程计和语义门检测，用于自主无人机竞速中的鲁棒实时定位，在高速场景下显著优于标准VIO。

title: RoSLAC: Robust Simultaneous Localization and Calibration of Multiple Magnetometers
summary: Localization of autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) in enclosed or semi-enclosed environments such as offices, hotels, hospitals, indoor parking facilities, and underground spaces where GPS signals are weak or unavailable remains a major obstacle to the deployment of fully autonomous systems. Infrastructure-based localization approaches, such as QR codes and RFID, are constrained by high installation and maintenance costs as well as limited flexibility, while onboard sensor-based methods, including LiDAR- and vision-based solutions, are affected by ambiguous geometric features and frequent occlusions caused by dynamic obstacles such as pedestrians. Ambient magnetic field (AMF)-based localization has therefore attracted growing interest in recent years because it does not rely on external infrastructure or geometric features, making it well-suited for AMR applications such as service robots and security robots. However, magnetometer measurements are often corrupted by distortions caused by ferromagnetic materials present on the sensor platform, which bias the AMF and degrade localization reliability. As a result, accurate magnetometer calibration to estimate distortion parameters becomes essential. Conventional calibration methods that rely on rotating the magnetometer are impractical for large and heavy platforms. To address this limitation, this paper proposes a robust simultaneous localization and calibration (RoSLAC) approach based on alternating optimization, which iteratively and efficiently estimates both the platform pose and magnetometer calibration parameters. Extensive evaluations conducted in high-fidelity simulation and real-world environments demonstrate that the proposed RoSLAC method achieves high localization accuracy while maintaining low computational cost compared with state-of-the-art magnetometer calibration techniques.
tldr: This paper proposes a robust simultaneous localization and calibration (RoSLAC) method for autonomous mobile robots, enabling accurate pose estimation and magnetometer calibration in GPS-denied environments without requiring physical rotation of the platform.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于自主移动机器人的鲁棒性同时定位与校准方法，能够在GPS信号弱的环境中实现高精度位姿估计和磁力计校准，且无需物理旋转平台。

title: MirrorBench: Evaluating Self-centric Intelligence in MLLMs by Introducing a Mirror
summary: Recent progress in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) has demonstrated remarkable advances in perception and reasoning, suggesting their potential for embodied intelligence. While recent studies have evaluated embodied MLLMs in interactive settings, current benchmarks mainly target capabilities to perceive, understand, and interact with external objects, lacking a systematic evaluation of self-centric intelligence. To address this, we introduce MirrorBench, a simulation-based benchmark inspired by the classical Mirror Self-Recognition (MSR) test in psychology. MirrorBench extends this paradigm to embodied MLLMs through a tiered framework of progressively challenging tasks, assessing agents from basic visual perception to high-level self-representation. Experiments on leading MLLMs show that even at the lowest level, their performance remains substantially inferior to human performance, revealing fundamental limitations in self-referential understanding. Our study bridges psychological paradigms and embodied intelligence, offering a principled framework for evaluating the emergence of general intelligence in large models. Project page: https://fflahm.github.io/mirror-bench-page/.
tldr: Introduces MirrorBench, a simulation-based benchmark inspired by psychological mirror self-recognition tests to evaluate self-centric intelligence in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for embodied agents.
tldr_zh: 提出了MirrorBench，一个受心理学镜像自我识别测试启发的模拟基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在具身智能体中的自我中心智能。

title: Tight Sample Complexity Bounds for Best-Arm Identification Under Bounded Systematic Bias
summary: As search depth increases in autonomous reasoning and embodied planning, the candidate action space expands exponentially, heavily taxing computational budgets. While heuristic pruning is a common countermeasure, it operates without formal safety guarantees when surrogate models (like LLMs) exhibit systematic evaluation biases. This paper frames the node expansion process as a localized Best-Arm Identification (BAI) problem over dynamic frontiers, subject to a bounded systematic bias $L$. By inverting the Lambert W function, we establish an additive sample complexity of $\mathcal{O}((Δ-4L)^{-2})$, which indicates that safe node elimination is only feasible when the empirical reward gap exceeds $4L$. We complement this with an information-theoretic lower bound of $Ω((Δ-2L)^{-2})$ to confirm the structural limits of biased search. Subsequent evaluations on both synthetic trees and complex reasoning tasks demonstrate that adhering to this local safety boundary successfully preserves optimal trajectories while maximizing sample allocation efficiency.
tldr: This paper analyzes the sample complexity of best-arm identification under systematic bias, framing node expansion in search/planning as a local BAI problem to provide safety guarantees when using biased surrogate models like LLMs.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了存在系统偏差下的最佳臂识别样本复杂度，将搜索规划中的节点扩展框定为局部BAI问题，为使用LLM等有偏差的代理模型时提供安全保证。

title: Chain of Modality: From Static Fusion to Dynamic Orchestration in Omni-MLLMs
summary: Omni-modal Large Language Models (Omni-MLLMs) promise a unified integration of diverse sensory streams. However, recent evaluations reveal a critical performance paradox: unimodal baselines frequently outperform joint multimodal inference. We trace this perceptual fragility to the static fusion topologies universally employed by current models, identifying two structural pathologies: positional bias in sequential inputs and alignment traps in interleaved formats, which systematically distort attention regardless of task semantics. To resolve this functional rigidity, we propose Chain of Modality (CoM), an agentic framework that transitions multimodal fusion from passive concatenation to dynamic orchestration. CoM adaptively orchestrates input topologies, switching among parallel, sequential, and interleaved pathways to neutralize structural biases. Furthermore, CoM bifurcates cognitive execution into two task-aligned pathways: a streamlined ``Direct-Decide'' path for direct perception and a structured ``Reason-Decide'' path for analytical auditing. Operating in either a training-free or a data-efficient SFT setting, CoM achieves robust and consistent generalization across diverse benchmarks.
tldr: This paper proposes a new framework, Chain of Modality, to improve multimodal large language models by dynamically orchestrating input modalities and task-aligned reasoning pathways, rather than using static fusion methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种名为Chain of Modality的新框架，旨在通过动态编排输入模态和任务对齐的推理路径来改进多模态大语言模型，而不是使用静态的融合方法。

title: Does RL Expand the Capability Boundary of LLM Agents? A PASS@(k,T) Analysis
summary: Does reinforcement learning genuinely expand what LLM agents can do, or merely make them more reliable? For static reasoning, recent work answers the second: base and RL pass@k curves converge at large k. We ask whether this holds for agentic tool use, where T rounds of interaction enable compositional strategies that re-sampling cannot recover. We introduce PASS@(k,T), a two-dimensional metric that jointly varies sampling budget k and interaction depth T, separating capability expansion from efficiency improvement. Our main finding is that, contrary to the static-reasoning result, tool-use RL genuinely enlarges the capability boundary: the RL agent's pass-curve pulls above the base model's and the gap widens at large k rather than converging. The expansion is specific to compositional, sequential information gathering; on simpler tasks RL behaves as prior work predicts. Under matched training data, supervised fine-tuning regresses the boundary on the same compositional tasks, isolating self-directed exploration as the causal factor. Mechanism analysis shows RL reweights the base strategy distribution toward the subset whose downstream reasoning more often yields a correct answer, with the improvement concentrated on how the agent integrates retrieved information. These results reconcile optimistic and pessimistic readings of RL for LLMs: both are correct, on different task types.
tldr: The paper investigates whether reinforcement learning expands the capabilities of LLM agents in tool-use tasks, introducing a new metric and finding that RL enables genuinely new compositional, sequential strategies that cannot be achieved by pure sampling.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了强化学习是否扩展了LLM智能体在工具使用任务中的能力，引入新指标并发现RL能实现真正新颖的、组合式、顺序式的策略，这是纯采样无法达到的。

title: Mean Flow Policy Optimization
summary: Diffusion models have recently emerged as expressive policy representations for online reinforcement learning (RL). However, their iterative generative processes introduce substantial training and inference overhead. To overcome this limitation, we propose to represent policies using MeanFlow models, a class of few-step flow-based generative models, to improve training and inference efficiency over diffusion-based RL approaches. To promote exploration, we optimize MeanFlow policies under the maximum entropy RL framework via soft policy iteration, and address two key challenges specific to MeanFlow policies: action likelihood evaluation and soft policy improvement. Experiments on MuJoCo and DeepMind Control Suite benchmarks demonstrate that our method, Mean Flow Policy Optimization (MFPO), achieves performance comparable to or exceeding current diffusion-based baselines while considerably reducing training and inference time. Our code is available at https://github.com/MFPolicy/MFPO.
tldr: Proposes Mean Flow Policy Optimization (MFPO), a few-step flow-based generative model for reinforcement learning policies, achieving comparable or better performance to diffusion-based methods with improved training and inference efficiency.
tldr_zh: 提出了均值流策略优化（MFPO），一种用于强化学习策略的少步流式生成模型，在保持与扩散模型相当或更好性能的同时，显著提高了训练和推理效率。

title: Momentum-constrained Hybrid Heuristic Trajectory Optimization Framework with Residual-enhanced DRL for Visually Impaired Scenarios
summary: Safe and efficient assistive planning for visually impaired scenarios remains challenging, since existing methods struggle with multi-objective optimization, generalization, and interpretability. In response, this paper proposes a Momentum-Constrained Hybrid Heuristic Trajectory Optimization Framework (MHHTOF). To balance multiple objectives of comfort and safety, the framework designs a Heuristic Trajectory Sampling Cluster (HTSC) with a Momentum-Constrained Trajectory Optimization (MTO), which suppresses abrupt velocity and acceleration changes. In addition, a novel residual-enhanced deep reinforcement learning (DRL) module refines candidate trajectories, advancing temporal modeling and policy generalization. Finally, a dual-stage cost modeling mechanism (DCMM) is introduced to regulate optimization, where costs in the Frenet space ensure consistency, and reward-driven adaptive weights in the Cartesian space integrate user preferences for interpretability and user-centric decision-making. Experimental results show that the proposed framework converges in nearly half the iterations of baselines and achieves lower and more stable costs. In complex dynamic scenarios, MHHTOF further demonstrates stable velocity and acceleration curves with reduced risk, confirming its advantages in robustness, safety, and efficiency.
tldr: This paper proposes a hybrid trajectory optimization framework for assistive planning in visually impaired scenarios, combining momentum-constrained optimization with residual-enhanced deep reinforcement learning to improve safety, comfort, and generalization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向视觉障碍场景的混合轨迹优化框架，结合动量约束优化和残差增强深度强化学习，旨在提高辅助规划的舒适性、安全性和泛化能力。

title: Graph Theoretical Outlier Rejection for 4D Radar Registration in Feature-Poor Environments
summary: Automotive 4D imaging radar is well suited for operation in dusty and low-visibility environments, but scan registration remains challenging due to scan sparsity and spurious detections caused by noise and multipath reflections. This difficulty is compounded in feature-poor open-pit mines, where the lack of distinctive landmarks reduces correspondence reliability. We integrate graph-based pairwise consistency maximization (PCM) as an outlier rejection step within the iterative closest points (ICP) loop. We propose a radar-adapted pairwise distance-invariant scoring function for graph-based (PCM) that incorporates anisotropic, per-detection uncertainty derived from a radar measurement model. The consistency maximization problem is approximated with a greedy heuristic that finds a large clique in the pairwise consistency graph. The refined correspondence set improves robustness when the initial association set is heavily contaminated. We evaluate a standard Euclidean distance residual and our uncertainty-aware residual on an open-pit mine dataset collected with a 4D imaging radar. Compared to the generalized ICP (GICP) baseline without PCM, our method reduces segment relative position error (RPE) by 29.6% on 1 m segments and by up to 55% on 100 m segments. The presented method is intended for integration into localization pipelines and is suitable for online use due to the greedy heuristic in graph-based (PCM).
tldr: This paper presents a graph-based outlier rejection method for 4D radar scan registration in feature-poor environments like open-pit mines, using a greedy heuristic to find a large clique in the pairwise consistency graph.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于图的异常值剔除方法，用于特征贫乏环境（如露天矿场）中的4D雷达扫描配准，使用贪心启发式算法在成对一致性图中寻找一个大的团。

title: OpenMobile: Building Open Mobile Agents with Task and Trajectory Synthesis
summary: Mobile agents powered by vision-language models have demonstrated impressive capabilities in automating mobile tasks, with recent leading models achieving a marked performance leap, e.g., nearly 70% success on AndroidWorld. However, these systems keep their training data closed and remain opaque about their task and trajectory synthesis recipes. We present OpenMobile, an open-source framework that synthesizes high-quality task instructions and agent trajectories, with two key components: (1) The first is a scalable task synthesis pipeline that constructs a global environment memory from exploration, then leverages it to generate diverse and grounded instructions. and (2) a policy-switching strategy for trajectory rollout. By alternating between learner and expert models, it captures essential error-recovery data often missing in standard imitation learning. Agents trained on our data achieve competitive results across three dynamic mobile agent benchmarks: notably, our fine-tuned Qwen2.5-VL and Qwen3-VL reach 51.7% and 64.7% on AndroidWorld, far surpassing existing open-data approaches. Furthermore, we conduct transparent analyses on the overlap between our synthetic instructions and benchmark test sets, and verify that performance gains stem from broad functionality coverage rather than benchmark overfitting. We release data and code at https://njucckevin.github.io/openmobile/ to bridge the data gap and facilitate broader mobile agent research.
tldr: The paper presents OpenMobile, an open-source framework for synthesizing task instructions and agent trajectories to train mobile agents, which achieve competitive performance on mobile agent benchmarks like AndroidWorld.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了OpenMobile，一个用于合成任务指令和智能体轨迹以训练移动智能体的开源框架，其在AndroidWorld等移动智能体基准测试中取得了有竞争力的性能。

title: Dual-Axis Generative Reward Model Toward Semantic and Turn-taking Robustness in Interactive Spoken Dialogue Models
summary: Achieving seamless, human-like interaction remains a key challenge for full-duplex spoken dialogue models (SDMs). Reinforcement learning (RL) has substantially enhanced text- and vision-language models, while well-designed reward signals are crucial for the performance of RL. We consider RL a promising strategy to address the key challenge for SDMs. However, a fundamental barrier persists: prevailing automated metrics for assessing interaction quality rely on superficial proxies, such as behavioral statistics or timing-prediction accuracy, failing to provide reliable reward signals for RL. On the other hand, human evaluations, despite their richness, remain costly, inconsistent, and difficult to scale. We tackle this critical barrier by proposing a Dual-Axis Generative Reward Model, which is trained to understand complex interaction dynamics using a detailed taxonomy and an annotated dataset, produces a single score and, crucially, provides separate evaluations for semantic quality and interaction timing. Such dual outputs furnish precise diagnostic feedback for SDMs and deliver a dependable, instructive reward signal suitable for online reinforcement learning. Our model achieves state-of-the-art performance on interaction-quality assessment across a wide spectrum of datasets, spanning synthetic dialogues and complex real-world interactions.
tldr: The paper proposes a Dual-Axis Generative Reward Model for evaluating spoken dialogue systems, focusing on semantic quality and turn-taking timing to provide better reward signals for reinforcement learning.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种双轴生成奖励模型，用于评估口语对话系统，专注于语义质量和话轮转换时机，为强化学习提供更好的奖励信号。

title: Benchmarking Classical Coverage Path Planning Heuristics on Irregular Hexagonal Grids for Maritime Coverage Scenarios
summary: Coverage path planning on irregular hexagonal grids is relevant to maritime surveillance, search and rescue and environmental monitoring, yet classical methods are often compared on small ad hoc examples or on rectangular grids. This paper presents a reproducible benchmark of deterministic single-vehicle coverage path planning heuristics on irregular hexagonal graphs derived from synthetic but maritime-motivated areas of interest.
